query:
select
  (select count(*)::int from orders where status in ('paid','partially_fulfilled','fulfilled','platform_settled')) as paid_orders,
  (select count(*)::int from orders) as all_orders,
  (select count(*)::int from payments where status in ('succeeded','platform_settled')) as succeeded_payments,
  (select max(created_at) from orders) as last_order_at,
  now() as measured_at
